ModMetaData.name: RimExodus Framework (Dev)
ModMetaData.author: Laurence-042
ModMetaData.description:
RimExodus 系列通用地图渲染框架与地图内结构操作工具包。提供多地图绘制与坐标映射、无 worldtile 口袋图、区域 prefab 序列化与重建、整图归档和地图 tick 速率控制。框架本身不添加玩法内容。
Shared map rendering and in-map structure toolkit for the RimExodus series. Includes map draw capture, transforms, pocket maps, region prefabs, whole-map archives and tick-rate controls. Gameplay policies belong to consumer mods.
